data.review_body:
I am extremely frustrated and angry with Shein’s customer service.
I placed an order more than a week ago. The money was successfully debited from my card, but the order is still not shipped. Instead, I’m stuck in an endless verification loop.
I have already sent all the required documents and transaction screenshots multiple times in the exact format they requested. Every time they reply with the same generic message: “screenshot is unclear”, “please resubmit via the link”. This is not customer service — this is pure harassment.
Shein has my money but refuses to ship the order. I have to waste my time every single day chasing them. The quality of their service is absolutely terrible.
If you value your time and nerves, I strongly advise you to avoid shopping at Shein.
I will be forced to file a chargeback with my bank and contact consumer protection authorities if my order is not shipped immediately.
------------------------------
I am extremely frustrated and disappointed with Shein’s so-called "customer service".
I placed an order more than a week ago. The money was successfully debited from my account. After that, I was forced into an endless verification hell. They kept asking me to send proof of payment again and again — screenshots, transaction records, etc. Every time they replied that the documents were "unclear" or "incomplete" and sent me new verification links.
I did everything they asked, multiple times. And what was the final result? Today they suddenly informed me that they are issuing a refund.
My question is: Why did you make me waste over a week sending you proof of payment if you could clearly see in your system that the money had already been received? What was the point of all this nonsense?
This is not fraud protection. This is pure disrespect and time-wasting. I had to chase them every single day, send documents repeatedly, and deal with generic replies. Absolutely terrible service.
If something goes wrong with your order at Shein — be prepared for stress, endless requests, and in the end, most likely a refund after wasting your time.
I do not recommend shopping here at all.
data.review_headline: Terrible Service – Wasting My Time for Over a Week!

data.review_body:
Clothes are cheap and good enough, you know what you’re getting etc.

My issue comes from the fact that they use Evri as a courier which typically lose most parcels, I’m now on 6 in a row! You have to experience it to believe it.

Ok, so this isn’t Sheins fault right? Yes and No, they could use alternate couriers or give the option to use alternatives, I’d happily pay more for something to arrive!

The real problem comes from customer services who instant on waiting for the full delivery time before they’ll process a refund, that’s despite sharing emails from Evri acknowledging it’s lost and being out for delivery for a week! Well I’m sorry, but you can cover the entire country in a week so unless it’s being walked here, I struggle to understand why I have to continue waiting! 

I even spoke to a person (supposedly) via chat and after checking photos and details they determined that it’s still in transit! Hmmm AI impersonating people maybe 🤷🏼‍♂️ who knows.
